author: terencechain
content:
Milen is right. The EL returned `null` for `eth_getBlockByHash` and our batch decoder turned that into "missing required field 'parentHash'". It just means block not found. Fixed in https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/17525

I think requesting a non-canonical block is expected here. This is the envelopes-by-root handler, which serves any root a peer asks for, including orphaned blocks we processed. Geth, Nethermind and Besu keep side chain blocks by hash, erigon, reth and ethrex drop them after, that explains the client split. https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/17526 makes us skip those hashes instead of failing the whole batch.

author: potuz
content: If the payload by root is for an unfinalized block then the EL should still have it. If it is for a finalized one then we shouldn't even request it
